name: video_soundfx
description: Generates a sound-effects track matched to what happens on screen and mixes it into the clip. Analyses the video, so no prompt is needed — pass one only to steer it. Music instead → `video_music`. A standalone effect with no video → `audio_sfx_generate`. Then `creations_show`.

creationIdentifier.description: Completed owned video creation to score.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

prompt.description: Optional steer, e.g. "footsteps on gravel, distant traffic". Omit to let the model read the clip.

trimSeconds.description: Optional: score only this window instead of the whole clip.
